prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1438; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for claim purposes. Do you understand and consent to being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Great. Can you walk me through what happened at the intersection in Katy?

A: I was making a left turn from the main road into the shopping center entrance. The light had turned yellow, so I was waiting for the oncoming traffic to clear before I went through.

Q: How fast were you moving when you began the turn?

A: Pretty slow, maybe ten or fifteen miles an hour. I had my signal on for a while before I started moving.

Q: What did you see in the other vehicle's direction?

A: There was a car coming toward me in the opposite lane. I thought it was far enough away, but it came up faster than I expected and hit the front passenger side of my car.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you receive any medical attention after the collision?

A: I went to urgent care that same afternoon. My neck was stiff and sore, and they diagnosed me with a neck strain. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any symptoms?

A: Yes, I still get headaches when I turn my head quickly, and my shoulders feel tight by the end of the day.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add before we finish?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to make sure my medical bills get taken care of.

Q: Understood. Thank you for your cooperation. We'll be in touch with next steps.

A: Thank you.
